intro_flavor: You read mud, wind, and silence before you read books. Game and danger taught the same lesson: move cleanly, or pay later. The cultivation world waits beyond the tree line—but you already know how to survive when plans fail.

history.family_or_household: A small hunting camp shared with an uncle and seasonal ranging partners.
history.hometown: Pinehollow, a village pressed against forested hills.
history.upbringing: Trails, traps, and nights under lean-to canvas.
history.education: Tracking, field dressing, and wilderness caution—literacy light but practical.
history.former_occupation: Village hunter and contract ranger for skins and meat.
memories: Losing a deer to wolves and learning when to abandon a trail.
Guiding a lost child out of the fog without asking for coin.
existing_obligations: Deliver one more rack of cured meat to the village storehouse.
favors: A warden overlooked a poaching rumor when you reported a beast sighting.

reputation_seeds.notes: Trusted for ranging when others stay home.

known_contacts.notes: Shares trail signs over cheap wine.

opportunities.label: Material gather
opportunities.notes: Collect beast parts for tanners and bone-workers.
